inclusion_criteria.text: Histologically or cytologically confirmed progressive advanced/metastatic HER2-positive breast carcinoma as per the updated American Society of Clinical Oncology (ASCO) – College of American Pathologists (CAP) guidelines according to local testing; HER2 status may be determined in the primary breast cancer tumour or, when not available, in a metastatic lesion
